featured_reviews.name: mahendra singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star Review for Geeta Caterers

I was unable to sleep last whole night because of the worst food experience and food my close friends and guest consumed last night.

Yesterday we hired Geeta Caterers for a birthday function of our daughter and it turned out to be an extremely disappointing experience. I rarely write reviews, but I feel it’s important to share this so others can make an informed choice.

The food quality and taste were extremely poor — not a single dish met even a basic satisfactory level. Hygiene was completely ignored, and the overall service was very unprofessional.

Before finalizing the order (for about 70 guests), we had requested a food tasting. Mr. Pramod mentioned they could only provide starters for tasting due to our lower guest count. The sample food sent home was indeed subpar, which he later admitted, assuring us that the food at the event would be of best quality and taste. Unfortunately, the actual food served was even worse.

To list a few issues:
•	No hygiene: Prepared chutneys, kebabs, and cheese balls were kept uncovered, later covered with polythene and floor bags when asked.
•	No proper cutlery: They didn’t even have basic serving bowls or forks ready. Guests were served noodles with disposable wooden forks at the last moment. However, since afternoon I kept asking them to show me where are forks and they said it’s inside.

Food quality: the main course menu was - noodles, manchurian gravy, pasta & pav bhaji.
•	Veg Manchurian gravy was watery and tasteless.
•	white Pasta had no taste and watery
•	Pav Bhaji was even poorly prepared and inedible.
Noodles were very ok ok types, not good.

We repeatedly checked with Mr. Pramod about their chef’s ability to handle pasta and other dishes, but despite assurances, the results were disappointing. The entire experience left us embarrassed in front of our guests.

Honestly, the only thing I’m thankful for is that some guests couldn’t make it and were spared this experience.

If there is an option for negative ratings, Geeta Caterers would deserve -10

It’s a humble request to please avoid placing any orders from Lazeez Caterers, Goregaon (Mr. Haroon Khan – Owner) for any occasion.

I dislike the fact that I have to give him one star too... I had contacted this caterer a week in advance to place an order for an important event. He called to confirm the order, provided a quote, and everything was finalized. However, his WhatsApp message suddenly disappeared, and it turned out he hadn’t even noted down the order.

When I followed up a day before the event to reconfirm, he first says, your order is tomorrow and you call today to place it? When i told him my order was placed a week back, he claimed that no such communication had taken place since he didn’t have any messages from me. Thankfully, I had taken a screenshot of our conversation, which I showed him. Instead of acknowledging the mistake, he began shouting angrily and falsely accused me of “always doing this” — even though this was my first time ordering from him.

He then canceled the order last minute, saying he didn’t want to take it on anymore.

This experience was extremely stressful and disappointing. The order was for an important event and last minute arrangements had to be done because of his carelessness. The lack of professionalism, the dishonesty, and the aggressive behavior makes it clear that this is not a reliable service provider. He clearly doesn't know how to run a business. I would strongly advise others to be cautious when confirming orders or consider alternative caterers.

Alen Vas

Alwyn and his team did a wonderful job in not just the catering but also the entire wedding planning. Every detail was planned minutely & the execution was done seamlessly. Our guests mentioned that this was the best wedding they have been to. We enjoyed our wedding to the fullest.

1. Decoration : The best decoration & lighting available in the market. Most of my friends have set this as their background in display pictures. The wedding car was also decorated in this package. Please opt for the selfie boot in the decoration, as the pictures there were amazing.
2. Food : The tastiest food out there. Adverse food variation & high quality. And best of all everything was done with extreme hygiene. Alron also helped us with a live bbq counter as per our requirements which was awesome.
3. DJ : The DJ Domnic was arranged by Alron. Domics work was very professional. We spoke multiple times to set up the right tracks to be played. The execution was done perfectly. We loved the music at the wedding.
4. Permission : All the permission were handled by Alron seamlessly. We had no issues whatsoever.
5. Attitude of the Staff : Firstly Alwyn is the best person I have ever dealt with. He made us feel like a family member. The entire staff at Alron was very polite and our guests were very pleased.

On the whole, Alrons services exceeded our expectations which was already very high. I would recommend everyone in and around Mumbai to have their wedding organized by Alron caterers.
